'''Igor Prünster''' is an Italian statistican who studies [[Bayesian inference]], in particular Bayesian nonparametrics and Bayesian asymptotics. He is professor of Statistics at [[Bocconi University]]. As of 2026, he is the editor-in-chief of the academic journal ''[[Bayesian Analysis (journal)|Bayesian Analysis]]''. He was the president of the [[International Society for Bayesian Analysis]] in 2021.

==Honours and awards==
* 2015: Fellow of the [[Institute of Mathematical Statistics]]<ref>{{cite web |title=IMS Fellows 2015 |url=https://imstat.org/2015/05/18/ims-fellows-2015/|access-date=7 July 2026}}</ref>
* 2018: Fellow of the [[International Society for Bayesian Analysis]]<ref>{{cite web |title=ISBA fellows |url=https://bayesian.org/membership/isba-fellows/ |access-date=7 July 2026}}</ref>
* 2019: Fellow of the [[American Statistical Association]]<ref>{{cite web |title=ASA Fellows |url=https://ww2.amstat.org/fellows/|access-date=7 July 2026}}</ref>
